image_description: A museum display featuring a large Triceratops skull mounted on a stand. The skull is the dominant subject, showcasing three horns and a large frill. The background includes museum walls, a doorway, and other exhibit elements. The lighting is artificial, casting shadows on the reddish carpeted floor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Three prominent horns: two long brow horns projecting forward and upward above the eyes, and a shorter nasal horn on the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the characteristic three-horn arrangement of a Triceratops skull: two large brow horns and one smaller nasal horn.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beak is parrot-like with a sharp, keratinous cutting edge.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rostral bone (beak) is visible at the front of the skull, exhibiting the typical parrot-like shape, though the keratinous sheath is missing as it is a fossil skeleton.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is quadrupedal with columnar, elephant-like limbs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image only displays the skull; the body and limbs are not visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Enormous bony frill (neck shield) extending posteriorly from the skull, with width dramatically exceeding the skull itself.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The large, solid bony frill is clearly visible extending behind the skull, consistent with Triceratops morphology.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Frill is solid bone with a smooth outer surface and possible epoccipital (marginal) bumps.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The frill appears solid (non-fenestrated) and has a textured surface consistent with fossilized bone and epoccipitals.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is inferred to have been covered in large, hexagonal scales with possible quill-like structures along the back and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a skeletal mount; no skin or soft tissue is present to evaluate.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Forelimbs are shorter than hindlimbs creating a sloping backline.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body and limbs are not visible in the image.
The tail is not visible in the image.
